mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET attempt=attempt+1,lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW(3))
UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=#{now},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error_category=NULL,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}
UPDATE outbox_event SET next_attempt_at=#{next},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error_category=#{category},last_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}
UPDATE outbox_event SET status='DEAD',dead_at=#{now},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error_category=#{category},last_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending, COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(created_at), #{now}), 0) AS oldestPendingAgeSeconds FROM outbox_event WHERE status='PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM outbox_event WHERE status='PUBLISHED' AND published_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY published_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM outbox_event WHERE status='DEAD' AND dead_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY dead_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE status='DEAD' ORDER BY dead_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PENDING',attempt=0,next_attempt_at=#{next},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL, dead_at=NULL,last_error_category='manual_retry' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DEAD'
